title: Hypnotic regression reveals mental contact with the creature
place_text: Crash site near Varginha; regression at a beach, Brazil

tellings.quote: report what's on the recording. It says that I was desperate trying to get closer. And the creature was speaking mentally, saying, "Calm down. Everything is fine. Go away. It's dangerous for you here.
I believe it because I saw the tape,
tellings.difference: Carlos tells it firsthand, says he saw the tape himself, and gives none of what the creature said.
tellings.link_reason: Carlos says he believes what telling 1 reports because he saw the tape of that same regression session.

as_told.title: Carlos sees recording of his own regression session

plain: Carlos de Souza says he came upon the crash site near Varginha, Brazil, in 1996, and that years later, under hypnotic regression (a hypnotist guiding someone back into a memory), at a beach in Brazil, a recording captured him recalling that he was "desperate trying to get closer" while the creature spoke to him in his mind: "Calm down. Everything is fine. Go away. It's dangerous for you here." He tells Michels that part as it was relayed to him by someone he names as Saga, and he also says he believes it "because I saw the tape" himself. If true, the creature at the crash would have been able to speak mind to mind.
